hardware.title: The latest laptops
hardware.description: Ready for something new? Laptops like the latest Dell XPS make amazing Omarchy machines, with our core team helping the newest hardware work properly.

hardware.title: Vintage Macs
hardware.description: Give that old Intel Mac a second life. Omarchy brings a fresh desktop to the hardware you already love.

hardware.title: Potato PCs
hardware.description: Even a 2011 ThinkPad X220 with 2GB of RAM can run Omarchy, with room to spare. Your old PC might have plenty left to give.

community.title: Meetups
